It is fixed in current version

requirement.summary: Unable to order in Simple Ordering Kiosk mode
requirement.description:
It is found that the station in simple ordering kiosk mode now is unable to order any items

Station setup:

- Infrasys POS platform --> POS system --> Station setup --> Stations --> target station

- Ordering mode = Self-order Kiosk

- Ordering Mode Sub Type = Simple Ordering Kiosk Mode

Workflow:

1. Login the client in simple ordering kiosk mode

2. Open the ordering panel

3. Click on the target menu list

Expected result:

System opens the menu list, displays the items inside and able to order item

Actual result:

System cannot open the menu list and has no response

requirement.summary: POS Interface - Use 'Pin' to verfiry patron identify on online Comp redemption
requirement.description:
Basic Information / request

vendor key : gems

It is required to generate hotfix under 1.2.112.0 for this enhancement

It is required to have configuration of this feature by workstation (* as it is only required for mobile POS) or have any way to make this take effect on mobile POS only

The change can only be made on mobile view only as this flow only require on mobile POS

Current situation

Refer to current interface specification (attached Interface Specification Document (ISD) GEMS - POS V1 28.pdf) from 3rd party on the gems interface, the field 'DateOfBirth' will be passed for feature 'Post online Comp' (attached screenshot-1.png of this function) based on Section 4.4 of the specification

Requirement

It is required to mask the 'Date of birth' field during input at mobile view. Attached screenshot-5.png is the expected sample screenshot.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-69026/Epic- 69024] POS Interface - Use 'Pin' to verfiry patron identify on online Comp redemption (Paker)
Descriptions:
It is available for GEMS gaming interface
It is available for vertical mobile view ONLY
System supports to mask date of birth input for post online comp payment
Workflow
1. Open a printed check
2. Click function “Paid” to go to cashier
3. Select the payment method attached with GEMS gaming interface having the payment type “Post Online Comp”
4. Input the patron number
5. Click button “Enquiry”
6. The system triggers the external party API for enquiry
7. The system displays the parton details returned in the response
8. If current station belongs to a station group configured in setup 1 AND station is vertical device, the system masking the input of date of birth
9. If the current station does not belong to any station groups configured in setup 1, or setup 1 is empty, or station is not vertical device, the system displays input of date of birth unmasked, follow all existing handling and end of operation
Setup:
For detailed setup of GEMS gaming interface, please refer to “hero_pos_release_note_1_0_19_0(HERO v1.2.19.0).doc”
New Functions: Support GEMS gaming interface enquiry and payment functions (3002)
Set default tab for interface setting
Go to Infrasys Cloud platform: Interface Control à Interfaces
Select target Gems gaming interface
Fill in the following interface setup
| Field Name | Description | Mandatory |
| Payment Setting | Payment Setting | Payment Setting |
| Station Groups for Masking Date of Birth (Setup 1) | Target Station Groups name L1 | No |
Click “Save” to save the record

requirement.summary: POS Feature - Hide sensitive information on enquiry and redemption function
requirement.description:
Basic Information / request

vendor key : gems

It is required to generate hotfix under 1.2.112.0 for this enhancement

It is required to have configuration of this feature by workstation (* as it is only required for mobile POS)

Current situation

Attached screenshot (screenshot-1.png and screenshot-2.png) is the sample display on 'Post online comp' and 'Patron inquiry' feature.

Below is the description on the field being displayed:

Patron number - masked

Point balance - Displaying the content

Point department - Displaying the content

Point earned today - Displaying the content

Requirement

It is required to change the field display as below. Attached is the expected sample result (screenshot-3.png and screenshot-4.png).

However, it is not necessary to change the UI and field structure

Patron number - The first three numbers should be displayed, and rest can be masked

Point balance - Display first two numbers and the remaining digits should be masked

For point balance, it should be integer.

If the points is 0, display as 0

If the points is 5, display as 5

If the points is 12, display as 12

if the points is 120, display as 12*

if the points is 1200, display as 12**

if the points is 12000, display as 12***

Point department - Display first two numbers and the remaining digits should be masked

If the points is 0.00, display as 0.**

If the points is 5.00, display as 5.**

If the points is 12.00, display as 12.**

if the points is 120.00, display as 12*.**

if the points is 1200.00, display as 12*.*

if the points is 12000.00, display as 12**.*

Point earned today - Display first two numbers and the remaining digits should be masked (up to 1dp)

If the points is 0.00, display as 0.**

If the points is 5.00, display as 5.**

If the points is 12.00, display as 12.**

if the points is 120.00, display as 12*.**

if the points is 1200.00, display as 12*.*

if the points is 12000.00, display as 12**.*
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-69025/Epic-69024] Hide sensitive information on enquiry and redemption function (Christopher)
Descriptions:
It is available for GEMS gaming interface
It is available for vertical mobile view ONLY
System supports to mask sensitive patron information in “Patron Inquiry” and “Post Online Comp” payment enquiry screen when the current station belongs to a station group configured in Setup [1] and the device is set to vertical mobile view
The mask format for each information is as follows:
Patron Number:
Display the first 3 characters and mask all remaining characters with asterisks (*)
Example: 12345678 → 123*****
Point balance:
Display the first 2 digits and mask all remaining digits with asterisks (*)
Omit the decimal places
Example:
12345.67 → 12***
-12345.67 → -12***
Point department / point earned today:
The masking rule depends on the number of digits before the decimal separator
For the integer portion (i.e. digits before the decimal separator)
3 or fewer digits:
Display the first 2 digits and mask all remaining digits with asterisks (*)
Example:
| Unmasked value | Masked value |
| 123.45 | 12*.** |
| 12.34 | 12.** |
| 1.23 | 1.** |
| 0.12 | 0.** |
4 digits:
Display the first 2 digits and mask the remaining digits before the decimal separator with 1 asterisk (*)
Example:
| Unmasked value | Masked value |
| 1234.56 | 12*.* |
| -1234.56 | -12*.* |
5 or more digits:
Display the first 2 digits and mask the remaining digits before the decimal separator with 2 asterisks (*)
Example:
| Unmasked value | Masked value |
| 12345.67 | 12**.* |
| -12345.67 | -12**.* |
| 123456.78 | 12**.* |
| -123456.78 | -12**.* |
For the decimal portion (i.e. digits after the decimal separator)
If the integer portion has 3 or fewer digits, display the decimal portion as two asterisks (**), regardless of the actual number of decimal places
If the integer portion has 4 or more digits, display only 1 decimal place and mask it with an asterisk (*)
For negative values, system will simply display the negative sign as it is
Workflow for Patron Inquiry
1. Open a check
2. Click function "Patron Inquiry"
3. Input the patron number
4. Click button "Enquiry"
5. The system triggers the external party API for enquiry
6. The system displays the patron details returned in the response
7. If the current station belongs to a station group configured in Setup [1] and the device is set to vertical mobile view, the system masks the patron number, point balance, point department, and point earned today
8. If the current station does not belong to any station group configured in Setup [1], or Setup [1] is empty, or the device is NOT set to vertical mobile view, the system follows the existing behavior to mask the patron number but displays the point balance, point department, and point earned today
Workflow for “Post Online Comp” payment
1. Open a printed check
2. Click function "Paid" to go to cashier
3. Select the payment method attached with the GEMS gaming interface having the payment type "Post Online Comp"
4. Input the patron number
5. Click button "Enquiry"
6. The system triggers the enquiry API
7. The system displays the patron details returned in the response
8. If the current station belongs to a station group configured in Setup [1] and the device is set to vertical mobile view, the system masks the patron number, point balance, and point department
9. If the current station does not belong to any station group configured in Setup [1], or Setup [1] is empty, or the device is NOT in vertical mobile view, the system follows the existing behavior to mask the patron number but displays the point balance and point department
Setup:
Setup [1]: Setting for station groups that require hiding sensitive information
Go to Infrasys POS Platform: Interface Control → Interfaces
Click “Add New” to configure a new setup OR edit an existing Gems gaming interface
Fill in the following interface setup
| Field Name | Description | Mandatory |
| Enquiry Display Settings | Enquiry Display Settings | Enquiry Display Settings |
| Station Groups for Hiding Sensitive Information | List of station group names in language 1  	 Format: [1st Station Group Name L1] [2nd Station Group Name L1]  E.g. Station Group 1 Station Group 2  Accept Station Group Name L1 only | Yes |
Click "Save" to save the record
For detailed setup of GEMS gaming interface, please refer to “hero_pos_release_note_1_0_19_0(HERO v1.2.19.0).doc”
New Functions: Support GEMS gaming interface enquiry and payment functions (3002)

requirement.summary: Unable to show the result for function "Print Past Date Check" with searching by table in MSSQL
requirement.description:
Pre-condition:

In MSSQL environment

Workflow:

1.Click function "Print Past Date Check"

2. Select target start and end date

3. Input table number

4. Click button "OK"

Actual result:

No results found

But the related check can be searched through the check number

Expected result:

- System able to search the list of past date checks when search by table number under MSSQL environment
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-68969] Unable to show the result for function "Print Past Date Check" with searching by table in MSSQL (Remain)
Descriptions:
In the MSSQL environment, when using “Print Past Date Check” with a specified table number, the system returns no records found, but the related check can be successfully searched by check number
Workflow
Click function “Print Past Date Check”
Select target start and end date
Input table number
Click button “OK”, no results found

But the related check can be searched through the check number
Expected result:
System able to search the list of past date checks when search by table number under MSSQL environment
It is fixed in current version
Setup:
None

requirement.summary: POS - Add Aspen owner code and status on Aspen display (Provide TMS Spec and Deploy to trunk)
requirement.description:
Provide Spec to TMS team and deploy to trunk for the search result base on same requirement in HERO-58101

Request to add one column Owner Code (to POS and TMS) at Apsen search member result.  the value is from POS searchmember function, by ario_code
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-58820,Jira-58373,Jira-68888/Epic-55419] POS - Add Aspen owner code and status on Aspen display (Andy)
Descriptions:
It is available for Aspen membership interface
It supports horizontal desktop view and vertical mobile view
System supports display the Owner Code from the returned enquiry result in member search list and details page of a member
Workflow
1. Open a new check
2. Click function “Set Member”
3. If setup "Display Owner Code in Member Enquiry Result” is empty or is set to No, follows existing workflow
Member search list shows “Member No.” and “Name” only (no “Owner Code” column)
Member details page does not show an “Owner Code” row
4. If setup “Display Owner Code in Member Enquiry Result” is set to Yes, go to step 5
5. System adds column “Owner Code” next to “Member No.” in the member search list
6. Input search criteria for member search
7. Click button “Enter”
8. System triggers external party API for Aspen member enquiry
9. If only one member is found, go to step 13
10. If more than one member is found, system shows the returned member search list
11. For each row in the list:
If the field “ARIO_CODE” of a member is returned with a non-empty value, system shows the value in “Owner Code”
If the field “ARIO_CODE” is missing or empty, system shows blank string in “Owner Code”
System follows existing handling for “Member No.” and “Name”
Horizontal View
Vertical Mobile View
12. Select target member
13. System shows the member details page for a member (i.e. tab “Basic Information”)
14. If the field “ARIO_CODE” of a member is returned with a non-empty value, system inserts a row “Owner Code” at the end of member details
Horizontal View
Vertical Mobile View
15. Click button “Set Member”
16. System stores the member details including “Owner Code” in the check
Setup:
Setup for display owner code in member enquiry result
Go to Infrasys POS platform: Interface Control  Interfaces
Click “Add New” to configure a new setup or edit existing setup
Select
Interface Type = Membership Interface
Vendor = Target ASPEN XML membership interface
Input a unique interface code in the field “Code”
Fill in the following interface setup
| Field Name | Description | Mandatory |
| General Setup | General Setup | General Setup |
| Display Owner Code in Member Enquiry Result | Display owner code in member enquiry result | Yes |
Click “Save” to save the record
For detailed setup of ASPEN XML membership interface, please refer to “hero_pos_release_note_1_0_0_0(HERO v1.2.0.0).doc”
Enhancements: Support new membership interface ASPEN

requirement.summary: POS API - Allow KDS to trigger unmark delivery through new API
requirement.description:
Enhancement:

Design new API for KDS to trigger Unmark Delivery function key

Parameter: outlet, check id, item id, quantity

POS supports a new API request in Api portal for unmark delivery for Shiji KDS interface usage

Use existing API Cloud logic to let Shiji KDS interface/other third party to trigger the unmark delivery action

- Only available for unmarked delivery and old items

- Support multiple unmarked delivery items in single request

- System supports unmark delivery for all items of a check when no items are given in the request

- System supports a new action print queue for unmark delivery (tbc)

Unsuccessful Scenario:

no table/check,

no item record,

table is not occuplied

table is locked

Error Handling:

- Table Locked or Vacant: Wait until the table unlock/the table status change to not vacant

- Cannot find the item under Check: follow the check number, unmark delivery for the remaining item

- Item has been unmarked as delivered: unmark delivery for the remaining item

Retry mechanism:

let KDS to retry
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-68814/Epic-60066] POS API - Allow KDS to trigger unmark delivery through new API (Paker)
Descriptions:
It is available for API Portal
System supports a new API request for unmark delivery for Shiji KDS interface usage
Use existing API Cloud logic to let Shiji KDS interface to trigger the mark delivery action
Only available for old items
Support multiple items in one request
System support unmark delivery for all items of a check when no items are given in the request
System supports a new action print queue setup for unmark delivery
Workflow for API portal
1. System receives the request for unmark delivery
2. If the target check cannot be opened, the system returns the exiting error message and abort action request
3. Open the target table
4. If Shiji KDS interface is attached to the outlet, system uses the provided internal check item ID to retrieve the target item
5. If Shiji KDS interface NOT attached, system use the item unique key (related to setup 1) to retrieve the target item
6. If the no items array provided in the request, loop all the items to clear the delivered status, go to step 10
7. If there is item array provided in the request, loop the item array one by one, go to next step
8. If the target item is not found in the check, the system treats this item as fail, and goes to step 12
9. If the target items are found, go to next step
10. If the corresponding item is NOT marked as delivered previously, the system treats this item as failed, and goes to step 12
11. If the corresponding item is marked as delivered previously, the system clears the delivered status
12. Go back to step 6 to proceed with the next item OR go to next step if it is last item
13. If setup 2 does not exist OR has the value “Yes”, system prints the slip mark delivery action slip
14. If setup 2 has the value “No”, the system does not print the action slip for mark delivery
15. If the delivered status of any items is cleared successfully, the system returns a successful response
16. If the delivered status of all items failed to be cleared, the system returns an error response
Setup:
For detailed setup of Shiji KDS interface, please refer to “infrasys_cloud_pos_release_note_1_0_104_0(Infrasys Cloud v1.2.104.0).doc”
Enhancements: [Jira-57492,Jira-57493,Jira-57494,Jira-58836/Epic-56913] POS - New KDS interface
Setup for “Item References Settings” under Config by Location
Go to Infrasys Pos platform: POS System à Ordering Setup à Config by Location
Select setup “Item References Settings”
Click “Add New” to add new record
Select
Apply To = Target location
All Locations = For all locations
Shop = For a specific shop
Outlet = For a specific outlet
Station = For a specific Station
Shop = Target shop (available only if “Shop” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Outlet = Target outlet (available only if “Outlet” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Station = Target station (available only if “Station” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Enable API portal generate item unique key = Yes (Setup 1)
Click “Save” to save record
Setup for action print queue
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System à Printing Setup à Action Print Queues
Select
Available in Locations = Target shop or outlet
Action Type = Target action type for mark delivery (Api Portal)
Print Format = Target print format
Print When Rollback = Target value (Setup 2)
Click “Save” to save record

requirement.summary: System may encounter problem if inputting invalid pattern in searching criteria of function "Check Listing"
requirement.description:
Workflow to simulate the problem:

1. Login to a station

2. Click button "Admin"

3. Select tab "Check Operation"

4. Click function "Check Listing"

5. In either of the check listing tab, click button "Search by Check No." / "Search by Member No." / "Search by Room No." / "Search by Table No."

6. Input the searching criteria with invalid pattern

7. System may crash after step 6

Expected result:

- System should not crash after step 6

Fixing scope:

- Cover all kind of searching criteria in step 5

- Fix the crashing problem

- While fixing the crashing problem, all possible valid pattern should still be able to search after fixing. Need to think is it possible to gather all valid pattern of Check No, Member No., Room No., Table No.
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-68375] System may encounter problem if inputting invalid pattern in searching criteria of function "Check Listing" (Simon Li)
Descriptions:
System may encounter errors and even crashes when users input invalid content as searching criteria in below functions in Check Listing page
Search by Member No.
Search by Check No.
Search by Criteria
Workflow for Check Listing functions
1. Login to a station
2. Click button “Admin”
3. Select tab “Check Operation”
4. Click function “Check Listing”
5. Click either function button “Search by Check No.” / “Search by Criteria” / “Search by Member No.”
6. Input the searching criteria with invalid pattern
7. System may crash after step 6
Expected Result:
System should allow all input patterns from users, while the system will not crash after searching
It is fixed in current version

requirement.description:
vendor: Gigi min program voucher Interface

Workflow Update Request: Gigi Mini Program Voucher Interface

Current Workflow:

- User clicks the payment key associated with the Gigi Mini Program voucher interface.

- System prompts the guest/operator to input the Amount.

- System prompts the guest/operator to input the Coupon Number.

- System sends the payload with the entered amount and coupon number to the Gigi Mini Program interface.

Expected Workflow:

- Set up a configurable default amount on the POS Display Panel (e.g., $50).

- User clicks the payment key associated with the Gigi Mini Program voucher interface.

- System directly prompts for the Coupon Number (skipping the manual amount entry step).

- System automatically sends the payload containing the pre-set default amount (e.g., $50) alongside the entered coupon number to the Gigi Mini Program interface.

System currently does not support the expected workflow for Gig Mini Program Voucher payment with a configured default voucher amount is configured.

Based on the video you shared and the remote configuration review held via Teams earlier, we have the following findings:

Setup Steps:

1.Payment method attached with the Gig min program voucher Interface

Unable to render embedded object: File (X6lwjAAAABklEQVQDAEOz8oOq4I1RAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC) not found.

2. Display Panel Page select target payment with default amount = 50

Unable to render embedded object: File (y4AAAAASUVORK5CYII=) not found.

Current system behaviour:

When a default amount is configured for the Gig Mini Program interface payment method with Payment Type "Settle Voucher", the system still prompts users to enter the Voucher amount. *

After manually entering a value in the voucher amount input box, the amount shown on the cashier screen uses the pre-configured default value rather than the manually entered figure.

This results in an incorrect balance calculation: Balance = Total - input amount - default amount.

System currently does not support the expected workflow for Gig Mini Program Voucher payment with a configured default voucher amount is configured.

It is available for GIG Mini Program non-gaming interface (Vendor key: gig_mini_program)
System supports to skip asking voucher amount if the default amount of the payment button of “Settle Voucher” is greater than 0
Workflow
1. Open a printed check
2. Click function “Paid” to go to cashier
3. Select the payment method attached with GIG Mini Program non-gaming interface and payment type sets as “Settle Voucher”
4. If the default amount of the payment method button is greater than 0,
If the default amount > check remaining total, system uses the remaining total as the voucher amount and go to step 8
If the default amount <= check remaining total, the system uses the default amount as the voucher amount and go to step 8
5. If the default amount of the payment method button does not exist or is set as 0, the system prompts an input box for voucher amount
6. Input the voucher amount
7. Click button “Enter”
8. The system prompts an input box for voucher QR code
9. Scan the QR code or manually input the value
10. The system triggers the external API for settle voucher
11. The system saves the payment
Setup:
For detailed setup of GIG Mini Program non gaming interface, please refer to “Infrasys_cloud_pos_release_note_1_0_81_0(Infrasys Cloud v1.2.81.0).docx”
New Functions: [Jira-32883,Jira-37223,Jira-37224/Epic-32722] POS Interface - GiG_mini_program Workflow enhancement
Set payment type as “Settle Voucher”
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System à Interface Configurations à Payment Settings
Select target payment method
Click “Add New” to add new record
Select
Apply To = Target location
All Locations = For all locations
Shop = For a specific shop
Outlet = For a specific outlet
Station = For a specific Station
Shop = Target shop (available only if “Shop” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Outlet = Target outlet (available only if “Outlet” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Station = Target station (available only if “Station” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Interface = Target GIG Mini Program non-gaming interface
Payment Type = Settle Voucher
Click “Save” to save record
Set payment default amount
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System à Station Setup à Display Panels
Select the cashier panel of target display panel
Click “Add New Button” to add a new payment button
Select
Type = Payment method
Available Options = Target payment method
Default Amount = Target payment amount
Click “Save” to save the record

requirement.summary: POS - GEMS - Add Setting to Display Photo & Signature First During Patron Enquiry
requirement.description:
User Story

As a Cashier, I want the patron's photo and signature to be displayed prominently on the Patron Enquiry result screen without navigating to another tab, so that I can visually verify the patron's identity before processing any transaction and reduce the risk of fraudulent or unauthorized activity.

Current Behavior

When a cashier performs a Patron Enquiry — either by tapping/swiping a patron card or by using the Patron Inquiry function key — the GEMS interface returns patron details (name, tier, points, etc.). The Patron Enquiry result screen displays patron information on two tabs; the photo and signature reside on a separate tab that the cashier must manually navigate to. There is no way to configure the system to show the photo and signature first. Cashiers may process transactions without seeing the photo/signature, creating a gap in identity verification.

Expected Behavior

A new toggle setting — "Display Photo & Signature First" — is added in the GEMS interface configuration. When the toggle is ON, the Patron Enquiry result screen displays the patron's photo and signature on the first/active tab alongside patron details, without requiring the cashier to navigate. When the photo and/or signature are not available in the GEMS response, a "Not Available" message is shown on the dedicated photo-and-signature tab. When the toggle is OFF, the existing behavior remain completely unchanged. The display automatically refreshes whenever a different patron account is selected or swiped. This enhancement applies both when the cashier manually invokes the Patron Inquiry function key and when a patron card is swiped/tapped during check open or ordering. Transaction processing (order entry, payment, voids, comps, etc.) is not affected.

Acceptance Criteria

GEMS Interface Setting - Toggle ON

- When the manager toggles the 'Display Photo & Signature First' setting ON

- Then the setting is saved per outlet and takes effect for all stations in that outlet without requiring a station restart

- And the Patron Enquiry result screen displays the photo-and-signature tab as the active first screen when a patron is queried

GEMS Interface Setting - Toggle OFF

- When the manager toggles the 'Display Photo & Signature First' setting OFF

- Then the Patron Enquiry result screen reverts to the existing default tab layout with no photo-and-signature-first behavior

- And all other patron enquiry functionality remains unchanged

Display Photo and Signature First - Both Available

- Given the 'Display Photo & Signature First' setting is ON for the outlet

- And the patron record in GEMS contains both a photo and a signature image

- When a cashier performs a Patron Enquiry by swiping/tapping a patron card or using the Patron Inquiry function key

- And both the photo and signature are clearly visible without requiring the cashier to navigate to another tab

- And the existing patron detail tabs remain accessible in their original positions

Display Photo and Signature First - Photo or Signature Not Available

- Given the 'Display Photo & Signature First' setting is ON for the outlet

- And the patron record in GEMS does not contain a photo, or does not contain a signature, or contains neither

- When a cashier performs a Patron Enquiry for that patron

- Then the Patron Enquiry result pop-up still displays the photo-and-signature tab as the active first tab

- And a 'Not Available' message is displayed on that tab

- And the patron details (name, tier, points, etc.) are still displayed and accessible on their respective tabs

Auto-Refresh on Patron Change

- Given the Patron Enquiry result screen is displayed showing Patron A's photo and signature

- When the cashier swipes a different patron card or selects a different patron account

- Then the screen automatically refreshes to display the new patron's photo and signature on the first tab

- And all patron detail fields update to reflect the newly selected patron

- And no residual data from the previous patron remains visible

No Impact on Transaction Processing

- Given the 'Display Photo & Signature First' setting is ON or OFF

- When a cashier processes any transaction (order entry, payment, void, comp, discount, refund, etc.)

- Then all transaction processing functions operate correctly and are unaffected by the photo-and-signature display setting

- And the Patron Enquiry result screen can be dismissed normally and does not block or delay transaction workflows

Supporting Evidence

Attach screenshots or mockups of the proposed Patron Enquiry result screen layout showing the photo-and-signature tab as the first tab, including the "Not Available" placeholder state.

Requested Timeline

Aligned with Priority: Medium

Preferred Quarter: [fill in]

Target Version: [fill in]

Notes: [fill in]

Alternatives Considered

1. Always show photo and signature first for all outlets without a toggle — rejected because different outlets have different operational security requirements and not all want the photo/signature to be the default view.

2. Show photo and signature as an overlay or pop-up on top of the patron details — rejected because it would obstruct patron detail information and add an extra dismissal step for the cashier.

3. Display photo and signature only on the One-Page Screen but not the Front Screen — rejected because the COD Manila Surveillance Team requires it on both screens for consistent identity verification.

Original Description (preserved by INF Prod. Studio)

Enhancement Detail

Vendor Key: gems{}

- Add setting in gems interface to display "Photo and Signature" tab first during member enquiry

- If both Photo and Signature is empty, display a message "Not Available"/"Photo and Signature Not Available" on "Photo and Signature" tab

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Enhancement Details:

Vendor Key: gems

Display the Photo and Signature of the Patron on the Front Screen.

Requirements:

- Display the Photo and Signature page first on the Screen.

- The display shall automatically refresh whenever a different patron account is selected.

- The enhancement shall not impact existing transaction processing functionality.

First Screen Patron Information

Second Screen: Patron Photo and Signature

User Story:

As a Cashier,

I want the patron's photo and signature to be displayed on the Front Screen and One-Page Screen without navigating to other tab.

So that I can verify the patron's identity before processing any transaction.

Workflow:

- Cashier Open a Check and Select "Patron Inquiry Function"

- Cashier Taps or Swipe Patron Card and send Patron Inquiry to GEMS.

- GEMS returned Patron Details, Patron Photo and Signature

- POS to display Patron Photo and Signature in One Page with Patron Details.

Scenario 1: Display Patron Photo and Signature

- Given a patron account has been successfully retrieved,

- When the Front Screen or One-Page Screen is displayed,

- Then the system shall display the patron's photo and patron's signature with details.

- And both shall be clearly visible without requiring additional navigation.

Scenario 2: Identity Verification

- Given the patron's photo and signature are displayed,

- When the cashier is about to process a transaction,

- Then the cashier shall be able to compare the displayed photo and signature with the patron present before proceeding.

Scenario 3: Photo or Signature Not Available

- Given the patron record does not contain a photo and/or signature,

- When the patron profile is displayed,

- Then the system shall display an appropriate placeholder or "Not Available" message.

- And the cashier shall follow the existing identity verification procedure.

Acceptance:

- Patron photo and signature are displayed on the screen.

- Existing functionality remains unaffected.

- User Acceptance Testing (UAT) completed and approved by COD Manila Surveillance Team and Operations.

requirement.summary: POS - Print Variable - Add Print Variable to Capture Extra Information for Payment Member
requirement.description:
User Story

As a POS operator, I want the guest check and payment receipt to display extra information for the payment member alongside the check member so that both members' details are visible on the same receipt when a member profile is linked to the payment tender.

Current Behavior

The existing print variable "MemberExtraInfoValue" is scoped exclusively to the check member and does not reference or iterate over payment members at all. When a payment is made using a tender that has a member profile linked (e.g., membership points redemption, membership stored-value card, loyalty payment), the receipt cannot display the payment member's extra information fields. Only the check member's extra information is available for printing.

Expected Behavior

A new print variable (name to be defined by the development team, following the existing "MemberExtraInfoValue" naming convention) is added to capture the extra information of the payment member. When a payment tender has a member profile linked, both the guest check and payment receipt shall display extra information for both the check member (via the existing "MemberExtraInfoValue" variable) and the payment member (via the new variable). The new variable must resolve correctly within the existing "CheckMemberExtrainfos" loop context, which already iterates over all members (check and payment). The new variable outputs the same data format and structure as "MemberExtraInfoValue" (key-value pairs for each configured extra information field).

Acceptance Criteria

Payment member extra information prints alongside check member extra information

- Given a check has a check member with extra information fields configured

- And the check is paid using a payment tender that has a different member profile linked, and that payment member also has extra information fields configured

- When the guest check is printed

- Then the extra information of the payment member is printed using the new print variable

- And the extra information of the check member is printed using the existing "MemberExtraInfoValue" variable

- And when the payment receipt is printed, it also displays extra information for both the check member and the payment member

- But if the payment member has no extra information fields configured, the new print variable outputs an empty string while the check member's extra information still prints normally

- But if the check member has no extra information fields configured but the payment member does, "MemberExtraInfoValue" outputs an empty string and the new variable prints the payment member's extra information

- But if the receipt template does not include the new print variable, only the check member's extra information appears and the payment member's extra information is absent

New variable resolves correctly within CheckMemberExtrainfos loop

- Given a receipt template includes the new print variable within the "CheckMemberExtrainfos" loop

- When the receipt is generated for a check paid with a tender that has a member profile linked

- Then the new variable correctly resolves to the payment member's extra information fields within the loop iteration

New variable outputs same data format as MemberExtraInfoValue

- Given a payment member has extra information fields configured (e.g., Member ID, Membership Tier, Points Balance)

- When the new print variable is rendered on a receipt

- Then the output format matches the existing "MemberExtraInfoValue" format — each extra information field is output as a key-value pair

- And all configured extra information fields for the payment member are included in the output

No output when payment tender has no linked member profile

- Given a check is paid using a payment tender that does not have a member profile linked (e.g., cash, generic credit card, voucher not linked to a member)

- When the receipt is printed

- Then the new print variable outputs an empty string for the payment member extra information

- And the check member's extra information is still printed via "MemberExtraInfoValue" if a check member is set

- But if no check member is set either, both variables output empty strings and the receipt prints without errors

Multiple payment members on a split-payment check

- Given a check has a check member with extra information fields configured

- And the check is split-paid using two different payment tenders, each with a different member profile linked, and both payment members have extra information fields configured

- When the receipt is printed

- Then the new print variable outputs the extra information for each payment member in the order their payments were applied

- And the check member's extra information is printed once via "MemberExtraInfoValue"

Supporting Evidence

N/A

Requested Timeline

Aligned with Priority: Medium

Preferred Quarter: TBD

Target Version: TBD

Notes: General product enhancement for the Hong Kong region.

Alternatives Considered

N/A

Original Description (preserved by INF Prod. Studio)

Background:-

Currently, it cannot display the extra information for the payment member as the print variable "MemberExtraInfoValue" captures only the extra information of the check member.  Therefore, it would need to add the print variable to capture the extra information of the payment member.

Enhancement Requests:-

It is needed to add the new print variable to capture the extra information for the payment member as the print variable "MemberExtraInfoValue" can only support for check member

Acceptance Criteria:-

The new print variable can capture the extra information of payment member for the loop of "CheckMemberExtrainfos"

requirement.summary: POS - Allow to Display of Payment Membership Number in Check Listing
requirement.description:
Background:-

Currently, it can only show the payment method for member payment and needs to enhance to display payment membership number for the member payment in Check Listing.

Enhancement Requests:-

It is needed to enhance in displaying the payment membership number for individual POS Check in Check Listing for

- Paid Check Listing (Current Station)

- Paid Check Listing

and the design is similar with payment method "Room Charge" with "Room#" next to it:-

Acceptance Criteria:-

1. It can display for the payment membership for "Member" payment method in "Paid Check Listing (Current Station)" in Check Listing

2. It can display for the payment membership for "Member" payment method in "Paid Check Listing" in Check Listing
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-66603] POS - Allow to Display of Payment Membership Number in Check Listing (Ryan Li)
Description:
System supports display payment membership number in below check listing pages:
Paid Check Listing (Current Station)
Paid Check Listing
The new column “Payment Member” has been added after the column “Payment Method”
Workflow
1. Login to POS client
2. Click button “Admin”
3. Select tab “Check Operation”
4. Click function "Check Listing"
5. Select the tab "Paid Check Listing (Current Station)" / "Paid Check Listing"
6. If setup 4 does not exist or has the value "No", system shows the standard listing UI without membership number
7. If the setup 4 has the value "Yes", system adds the column for "Payment Member" to the listing
If setup 1, setup 2, setup 3 were fulfilled if the payments of checks were saved, the payment membership number of the checks will be displayed in the new column
Otherwise, the value will be empty
Setup:
Add a member type payment
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System  Payment Setup  Payment Methods
Click “Add New” to add a new record
Select
Type = Member [Setup 1]
Click “Save” to save record
Add member profile setup under Config by Location
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System  Ordering Setup  Config by Location
Select “Member Profile (For Membership in Member Module)” under “System” section
Click “Add New” to add a new record
Select
Apply To = Target location
All Locations = For all locations
Shop = For a specific shop
Outlet = For a specific outlet
Station = For a specific Station
Shop = Target shop (available only if “Shop” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Outlet = Target outlet (available only if “Outlet” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Station = Target station (available only if “Station” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Support = Yes [Setup 2]
Target membership interface = Target membership interface [Setup 3]
Click “Save” to save record
Add check listing setup under Config by Location
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System  Ordering Setup  Config by Location
Select “Check Listing Setting” under “System” section
Click “Add New” to add a new record
Select
Apply To = Target location
All Locations = For all locations
Shop = For a specific shop
Outlet = For a specific outlet
Station = For a specific Station
Shop = Target shop (available only if “Shop” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Outlet = Target outlet (available only if “Outlet” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)

Display Membership Number in Check Listing = Yes [Setup 4]

requirement.summary: POS Feature - Action Slip for scheduled Item (Dev 2/2)
requirement.description:
Enhancement Details

- Dev case 2/2 for https://jira.shijidev.com/browse/HERO-45421
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-62138,Jira-62139/Epic-45421] POS Feature - Action Slip for scheduled Item
Descriptions:
It is supported to print an action slip after a specified delay following scheduled items are being sent to the kitchen
The following information is supported on the action slip:
Items
Table number with table extension
Check number
Due time
Workflow
1. Open a new check
2. Order scheduled items, either by the function “Set Item Scheduling” or by setting an auto fired time for pending item
3. Click function "Send Check"
4. The system prints the kitchen slip when the scheduled time is reached
5. After the delay specified in the setup “Delay time of printing action slip”, the system prints an action slip
Setup:
Add a setup under Action Print Queues
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System  Printing Setup  Action Print Queues
Click "Add New" to add a record
Select
Action Type = Scheduled Item Sent
Click "Save" to save the record
Add a setup under Config by Location
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System  Ordering Setup  Config by Location
Select setup "Scheduler For Sending Item"
Click "Add New" to add a record
Select
Apply To = Target location
All Locations = For all locations
Shop = For a specific shop
Outlet = For a specific outlet
Station = For a specific station
Shop = Target shop (available only if "Shop" is selected in "Apply To")
Outlet = Target outlet (available only if "Outlet" is selected in "Apply To")
Station = Target station (available only if "Station" is selected in "Apply To")
Turn on scheduler = Yes
Delay time of printing action slip = Target delay time in minutes
Click "Save" to save the record

Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name, Default: No | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Outlets | (multi-select) Outlet(s) included in the report. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name, Default: No | All, Single, Multiple | All |

| Report Format | (single-select) Summary displays whole day information; Detail displays each period and whole day information. | Summary, Detail | Detail |
| Display Figure | (single-select) Net displays item Net Sales (item Gross Sales - discount); Gross displays item Gross Sales. | Net, Gross | Net |
| Show Discount Section | (single-select) Yes displays discount information; No does not display it. | Yes, No | Yes |
| Show Grand Total | (single-select) Yes displays Discount and Payment Grand Total; No does not display Grand Total. Grand Total requires selecting more than one outlet. | Yes, No | No |

| Attribute Key | (multi-select) Attribute key(s) used to filter the reported data. | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Hide Cash | (single-select) Invalid when Hide Cash is specified in Config By Location. Yes hides payment data whose payment type is Cash unless excluded users apply (Config by Location "Hide Cash Payment In Report" with Exclude By User Group); No displays all data. | Yes, No | No |

requirement.summary: POS Report - POS305 PH BIR Sales Summary Report V2 - Layout, labeling and Z-Counter enhancements
requirement.description:
User Story

As a Shiji Philippines operator preparing BIR-accredited sales reports, I want the POS305 PH BIR Sales Summary Report V2 adjusted (Grand Accum. Ending Balance, deduction/discount signs, Service Charge label and column order, and Z-Counter logic) so that the report output meets BIR requirements.

Current Behavior

The POS305 PH BIR Sales Summary Report V2 currently:

- Displays the 'Grand Accum. Ending Balance' column with a value that does not follow the 'Gross Amount' column.

- Shows negative signs on Deduction and Discount columns.

- Labels the column 'Service Charge (without VAT)'.

- Positions 'Service Charge' and 'Local Tax' before 'Net Amount'.

- Uses a Z-Counter that does not reflect the shop's daily close count.

Expected Behavior

The POS305 PH BIR Sales Summary Report V2 should reflect the following changes:

- 'Grand Accum. Ending Balance' follows the existing 'Gross Amount' column value.

- All negative signs are removed from Deduction and Discount columns; values display as positive amounts.

- The 'Service Charge (without VAT)' column header is renamed to 'Service Charge'.

- 'Service Charge' and 'Local Tax' columns are moved to appear immediately after 'Net Amount'.

- The Z-Counter increments only after a fully successful End of Day (Business Day) process, representing the shop's Daily Close Count, and resets to zero at the start of each business day.

- Changes apply only to the Philippines version of the POS305 report; other regions keep the current layout.

Acceptance Criteria

Grand Accum. Ending Balance follows Gross Amount

- Given the POS305 PH BIR Sales Summary Report V2 is generated

- Then the 'Grand Accum. Ending Balance' column displays the same value as the 'Gross Amount' column

Deductions and Discounts shown as positive amounts

- Given the report contains values in the 'Discounts', 'Returns', 'Voids', 'Total Deductions', 'Discount', 'VAT on Returns', 'Others', and 'Total VAT adjustment' columns

- Then all these columns display values without any negative sign

- And all these columns display values as positive amounts

- But if a column value is zero, it displays as zero with no sign

Service Charge column header updated

- Given the report is generated

- Then the column header reads 'Service Charge' with no 'Without VAT' wording

Service Charge and Local Tax columns reordered

- Given the report is generated

- Then the 'Service Charge' and 'Local Tax' columns appear immediately after the 'Net Amount' column

- And no other columns are inserted between 'Net Amount' and 'Service Charge' or between 'Service Charge' and 'Local Tax'

Z-Counter increments only on successful EOD

- Given a shop runs an End of Day (Business Day) process

- When the EOD completes successfully with no errors and all steps finished

- Then the Z-Counter increments by one after daily close

Z-Counter resets each business day

- Given a new business day starts for the shop

- Then the Z-Counter resets to zero

- And the Z-Counter reflects the shop's Daily Close Count for that business day only

Changes limited to Philippines version

- Given the POS305 report is generated for a non-Philippines region

- Then the report keeps its current layout and labeling unchanged

Supporting Evidence

The report is only viewed on screen and printed for BIR submission; no other systems or downstream processes consume its output. The changes apply only to the Philippines version of the POS305 report.

Requested Timeline

Aligned with Priority: Medium

Preferred Quarter: [not specified]

Target Version: [not specified]

Notes: This enhancement is part of the Shiji Philippines BIR Accreditation requirement.

Original Description (preserved by INF Prod. Studio)

Enhancement Details

POS305 PH BIR Sales Summary Report V2

Original Report

1. 'Grand Accum. Ending Balance' copy the amount from 'Gross Amount'

2. Remove all negative sign for 'Deductions' and 'Discounts' columns

3. 'Service Charge (without VAT)' column rename to 'Service Charge'

4. Move columns 'Service Charge' & 'Local Tax' after 'Net Amount'.

5. Column 'Z-Counter' should be the number of daily close count in End Of Day (Business Day). When selecting multiple dates, calculate base on the number of days total.

_______________________________________________________________________________________________

Business Requirement

Use the existing POS305 PH BIR Sales Summary Report V2 as the baseline report and implement the following enhancements:

Update and adjust the following Columns

- Grand Accum. Ending Balance

-

- Review and update the Grand Accum. Ending Balance column as required in the report output.

- Deductions and Discounts

-

- Remove all negative signs (-) displayed in all Deductions and Discount related columns.

- Values should be displayed as positive amounts.

- Service Charge Column Header

-

- Update the Service Charge column header.

- Remove the wording "Without VAT" from the column name.

- Column Reordering

-

- Move the following columns to appear immediately after the Net Amount column:

- Service Charge

- Local Tax

- Z-Counter Logic

-

- Update the Z-Counter value calculation.

- The Z-Counter should increment only after a successful End of Day (EOD)-Business Day process is completed for the shop.

- This value should represent the shop's Daily Close Count.

User Stories

As part of the Shiji Philippines BIR Accreditation. BIR Requires adjustment on the POS305 BIR Sales Summary Report

Enhancement Request

1. Grand Accum Ending Balance should be the Gross Amount of the Day

2. Remove ALL the Negative sign on the Deductions and Discount

3. Remove the Without VAT wording on the Service Charge Column.

- Moved Service Charge and Local Tax column after Net Amount Column.

- Z-Counter - Value will count after successful EOD of the Shop. (Daily Close Count)

Acceptance Criteria

- POS305 PH BIR Sales Summary Report V2 reflects all requested layout and labeling changes.

- Deductions and Discounts are displayed without negative signs.

- Service Charge column no longer contains the text "Without VAT".

- Service Charge and Local Tax columns are positioned after Net Amount.

- Z-Counter increments only after a successful EOD execution and accurately reflects the Daily Close Count.

requirement.summary: Report Console — Opening a report in Report Viewer is very slow on the first load for non-admin HQ users with many outlets
requirement.description:
Summary

Opening a report in Report Viewer is very slow on the first load for non-admin HQ users with many outlets

Preconditions (important)

- Reproduce with a non-admin user (User Role is not Administrator / user_role != a).

- The user must see a large outlet set (e.g. HQ / multi-property, hundreds to thousands of outlets). Hyatt HQ evidence ≈ 2800 outlets.

- Report authority cache for that user + report must be cold (no rows yet, or those rows cleared).

- Do not use an Administrator account to reproduce the multi-minute delay — admin skips the heavy per-outlet authority evaluation, so the extreme first-load wait will not match customer evidence.

Background

- User action: open any report from Report Console (URL path report/reports/view/...)

- The delay is Waiting / TTFB on the view page, before the BIRT report engine runs — not the report’s own SQL and not download time

- Related (listing already improved; opening via view was still slow on first load):

- HERO-63472 — Report Console listing: in-memory caching

- HERO-62187 — Optimize report list loading

- HERO-50240 — optimize view report / Set Report Authorities loading

Problem

When a non-admin user opens a report via reports/view, the server builds report authority cache for every outlet visible to that user before returning the viewer page.

On a large HQ (e.g. Hyatt ≈ 2800 outlets), the first open used to look up cache per outlet; on miss it evaluated report ACL with multiple SQL queries per outlet (no request-level memoization like listing in HERO-63472), then inserted ~N cache rows.

BIRT OutletList still needs this full per-outlet cache before the report can run. Listing optimization only covers “allowed on at least one outlet” and does not remove this work when opening a report.

Steps to Reproduce

- Log in as a non-admin HQ user with a large outlet set.

- Ensure report ACL cache for that user + the target report is empty (or clear those cache rows).

- From Report Console, open any report (view page report/reports/view/...).

- In browser DevTools Network, check Waiting / TTFB for the reports/view/... document request.

- Open the same report again without clearing ACL cache (warm path).

Expected Result

First open of Report Viewer returns within a few seconds even when the customer has thousands of outlets (non-admin, cold cache).

Actual Result (before fix)

- First open (non-admin, cold cache, ~2800 outlets): Waiting (TTFB) ≈ 2.7 minutes on reports/view.

- Second open (cache already built): ≈ 1.57 seconds.

- Bottleneck: building report ACL cache on the server for every outlet, not BIRT SQL / network download.

Fix direction (implemented)

Optimize genReportAclCacheByReport used when opening Report Viewer (and aligned module copies):

- Batch-load existing ACL cache for (user, report); return early when all outlets are already cached

- Reuse listing-style memoized ACL checks for non-admin; admin fast-path allow-all

- Chunk bulk inserts (e.g. 500)

Still write full per-outlet cache before BIRT. Do not only cache selected shops (missing rows = no access in OutletList).

References

- Entry: report/reports/view

- Related: HERO-63472, HERO-62187, HERO-50240

- Customer: Hyatt HQ, ~2800 outlets

- Release Note: Release_Note_HERO-68473.docx
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [HERO-68473] Report Console - Opening a report in Report Viewer is very slow on the first load for non-admin HQ users with many outlets
Descriptions:
When a non-admin HQ user with a large outlet set opens a report from Report Console for the first time (report authority cache is empty for that user and report), Infrasys Cloud builds per-outlet report authority cache before the Report Viewer page returns. On a large HQ with about 2800 outlets, Waiting (TTFB) for the view page was about 2.7 minutes. Opening the same report again (cache already built) was about 1.57 seconds. The wait is on the view page itself, before the report engine runs, and is not caused by the report SQL.
This case optimizes that first-load authority cache build so Report Viewer opens much faster for the same non-admin HQ scenario, while still writing full per-outlet cache rows required by the report outlet list. Admin users are not the target reproduce path for the multi-minute delay (they do not run the heavy per-outlet authority evaluation).
Configuration / Parameter:
No special configuration or parameter is required.
No new report parameter or system setting is added by this case.
Field Definition:
This case does not involve field definition.
Result / Sample:
After this fix, when a non-admin HQ user with many outlets opens a report in Report Viewer for the first time with a cold authority cache, the view page returns in a few seconds instead of about 2.7 minutes. Opening the same report again remains fast (about the previous warm-path level).
Report access rules and the outlet list used by the report are unchanged. Missing cache rows are still treated as no access for the outlet list.

requirement.description:
Ticket ID: #1938720

Subject: Total tip amount not displayed in POS050  after the last upgrade

Department: Infrasys Support

URL: https://support-intl.shijigroup.com/agent/shijigroupintl/infrasys-support/tickets/details/255139001017331093

- Run POS050 – Cashier Report (By Outlet).

- Tips > 0 on one or more payments (paym_tips not Residue), and

- No Residue payments (paym_tips = 'r'), so Residue total is null/empty (not 0.00).

- Check the Total row for that outlet/meal period.

| Date Type | (single-select) Picking current business day displays current business day data; picking last business day displays last business day data; picking specified as below displays specified period day data. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit | Current Business Day, Last Business Day, Specified as Below | Current Business Day |
| Day Of Week | (multi-select) Exclude data of selected day(s) of week; unselected shows all. | All, Single, Multiple | All |

| Day Of Month | (input) Exclude data of specified day(s) of month; empty shows all. | - | - |
| Shops | (multi-select) Select all shops displays all shops data, select a single shop displays single shop data, select multiple shops displays multiple shops data. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Outlets | (multi-select) Select all outlets displays all outlets data, select a single outlet displays single outlet data, select multiple outlets displays multiple outlets data. | All, Single, Multiple | All |
| Period | (multi-select) Select all periods displays all periods data including undefined period data, select a single period displays single period data, select multiple periods displays multiple periods data. | All, Single, Multiple | All |

| Zero Payment | (single-select) Show keeps the payment type column with zero amount displayed; Hidden hides the payment type column with zero amount. | Show, Hidden | Show |

Note: Show the data of open check and settle check. Carry forward check data is only displayed on the business day of check, if the carry forward check does not change on the next business day, it will not be displayed on the next business day. If the carry forward check has other operations on other business days, the changed data should only be displayed on other business days (the changed data needs to be closed daily before it can be displayed). requirement.summary: POS018 Discount Report — optimize loading performance
requirement.description:
Summary

POS018 Discount Report — optimize loading performance

Background

- Report: POS018 — Discount Report

- Design file: Plugin/Pos/webroot/reports/item_discount/item_discount.rptdesign

- Customer: ACCOR HOTELS & RESORTS HQ

- Support: Ticket #1933236 — Report POS018 - not able to generate

- URL: https://support-intl.shijigroup.com/agent/shijigroupintl/infrasys-support/tickets/details/255139001015393106

- Main dataset: CheckDiscountsItems (also CheckNumber, sBizDays, DiscountTypes)

Problem

Dataset CheckDiscountsItems is slow / fails to generate under multi-day or last-month runs. Hotspots:

- Correlated scalar subquery incl_sc on pos_check_tax_sc_refs per citm_id (ctsr_variable LIKE 'incl_sc_ref%') — DEPENDENT SUBQUERY once per discount-item row.

- LEFT JOIN derived table(s) on pos_check_extra_infos for discount reference (and optionally reason) that re-join pos_checks + pos_business_days with the same date/outlet filters as the outer query, then GROUP BY — materialize + hash join cost grows with range.

- When Show Discount Reason / detail: nested (SELECT dirs_name_lN FROM pos_discount_reasons WHERE dirs_id = ckei_value) inside the reason derived table.

- last_month uses YEAR(bday_date) / MONTH(bday_date) (non-SARGable) in CheckDiscountsItems / CheckNumber / sBizDays — bad join order (drive from pos_discount_types → all discounts) vs date-range path.

Steps to Reproduce

- Open POS018 — Discount Report (MySQL).

- Select Accor / multi-outlet (or one busy outlet); date type Specified (~7 days), then Last month.

- Enable discount reference (and optionally detail + show discount reason); run report.

- Capture CheckDiscountsItems SQL from beforeOpen and run EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE.

Expected Result

- Outer path should stay date/outlet-driven (bday → checks → discounts → discount items → items), without per-row correlated incl_sc scans when a join aggregate is possible.

- Discount reference / reason should join pos_check_extra_infos once (via ckei_cdis_id / scoped map), not re-scan all checks in range inside a derived table.

- last_month should use a SARGable range on bday_date (same shape as specified).

Actual Result

- EXPLAIN: DEPENDENT SUBQUERY on pos_check_tax_sc_refs (index item on ctsr_citm_id; filter still includes LIKE 'incl_sc_ref%').

- Reference derived table materializes pos_check_extra_infos joined through checks/bdays for the same filter window (duplicate work vs outer join).

- last_month YEAR/MONTH vs date-range rewrite (same outlet/month, same 26k result rows): YEAR/MONTH ~135s vs range ~2.9s (46× slower); YEAR/MONTH plan drives from pos_discount_types / type index over discounts instead of outlet_date range on pos_business_days.

- Support ticket: report not able to generate (timeout / long load).

Root Cause

- CheckDiscountsItems beforeOpen SELECT list includes:

IFNULL((
SELECT SUM(IFNULL(ctsr_value, 0)) AS incl_sc
FROM pos_check_tax_sc_refs
WHERE ctsr_variable LIKE 'incl_sc_ref%'
AND ctsr_status <> 'd'
AND ctsr_by = 'item' AND ctsr_citm_id = citm_id
AND ctsr_olet_id IN (...)
GROUP BY ctsr_citm_id
), 0) AS incl_sc

- Discount reference branch (sShowAllDiscountReference != 'yes') builds:

LEFT JOIN (
SELECT ckei_value, ckei_chks_id, ckei_citm_id, ckei_cdis_id
FROM pos_check_extra_infos
JOIN pos_checks ON (ckei_chks_id = chks_id
AND ckei_section = 'discount' AND ckei_variable = 'reference')
JOIN pos_business_days ON bday_id = chks_bday_id AND <sBizDays> ...
WHERE ckei_status <> 'd' AND chks_status <> 'd' ...
GROUP BY ckei_cdis_id, ckei_citm_id
) extra_info ON extra_info.ckei_cdis_id = cdis_id

- Discount reason branch adds another similar derived table plus correlated pos_discount_reasons lookup by ckei_value.

- Date filter for last month:

YEAR(bday_date) = <y> AND MONTH(bday_date) = <m>

- Secondary issues (fix together or as follow-ups):

- sShowAllDiscountReference = 'yes' path joins discounts + discount_items + checks + extra_infos again inside the derived table — heavier than the default branch.

- Parameter string concatenation (shops/outlets/discount types/dates) — common BIRT pattern; validate ID lists.

- GROUP BY ckei_cdis_id, ckei_citm_id while selecting non-aggregated ckei_value — nondeterministic under ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY (prefer GROUP_CONCAT / MAX).

Suggested Fix

- Primary — remove correlated incl_sc:

- LEFT JOIN pre-aggregate:

LEFT JOIN (
SELECT ctsr_citm_id, SUM(IFNULL(ctsr_value, 0)) AS incl_sc
FROM pos_check_tax_sc_refs
WHERE ctsr_status <> 'd' AND ctsr_by = 'item'
AND ctsr_variable LIKE 'incl_sc_ref%'
AND ctsr_olet_id IN (...)
GROUP BY ctsr_citm_id
) sc ON sc.ctsr_citm_id = citm_id

- Or move incl_sc into a Script/map dataset (POS017 Hybrid style) keyed by citm_id.

- Discount reference / reason:

- Prefer direct LEFT JOIN pos_check_extra_infos ON ckei_cdis_id = cdis_id AND ckei_section/variable ... (index discount on ckei_cdis_id) with GROUP_CONCAT in the outer query, or one scoped derived table without re-joining all checks/bdays.

- Reason id → name: LEFT JOIN pos_discount_reasons ON dirs_id = ckei_value instead of scalar subquery in CASE.

- last_month: replace YEAR/MONTH with bday_date >= '<first_day>' AND bday_date <= '<last_day>' in CheckDiscountsItems, CheckNumber, sBizDays.

- Optionally validate numeric IN-lists before concatenation.

Suggested SQL shape (illustrative)

-- last_month
bday_date >= '2018-07-01' AND bday_date <= '2018-07-31'

SELECT ... , IFNULL(sc.incl_sc, 0) AS incl_sc, ...
FROM pos_check_discounts
JOIN pos_discount_types ON dtyp_id = cdis_dtyp_id
JOIN pos_check_discounts_items ON cdit_cdis_id = cdis_id AND cdit_status <> 'd'
JOIN pos_check_items ON citm_id = cdit_citm_id
JOIN pos_checks ON chks_id = cdis_chks_id
JOIN pos_business_days ON bday_id = chks_bday_id AND <sBizDays>
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT ctsr_citm_id, SUM(IFNULL(ctsr_value, 0)) AS incl_sc
FROM pos_check_tax_sc_refs
WHERE ctsr_status <> 'd' AND ctsr_by = 'item'
AND ctsr_variable LIKE 'incl_sc_ref%'
GROUP BY ctsr_citm_id
) sc ON sc.ctsr_citm_id = citm_id
LEFT JOIN pos_check_extra_infos ref
ON ref.ckei_cdis_id = cdis_id AND ref.ckei_status <> 'd'
AND ref.ckei_section = 'discount' AND ref.ckei_variable = 'reference'
WHERE chks_status <> 'd' AND citm_status <> 'd' AND cdis_status <> 'd' ...

References

- Report code: POS018

- Support ticket: #1933236

- Architecture reference (optional follow-up): POS017 Hybrid — Script DataSets + in-memory maps for heavy extra-info / tax-sc lookups

# <<< [Not Included In STD Release] >>>
New Functions: [JIRA-67615] KDS2.0 - Create new API to show ticket history in client
Descriptions:
Allowed KDS client to view the history of a ticket in a timeline (latest on top).
In the ticket event, the first row is the timestamp that this action is performed. The second row is the event type name. The third row is the entry/course/menu related to the event. If there is both an entry and a course/menu involved, it will be shown as “{entry name} · {course/menu name}”.
These events will be logged to backend ticket history table when performed:
Ticket Created
Item course created
Item menu created
Item created
Item quantity updated at POS
Addon Item created at KDS
(If an item has already been sent to the kitchen (fired) and its quantity is increased at the POS, the KDS will automatically generate an 'addon' item for the additional quantity)
Addon Item void at KDS
(If an item's quantity is reduced to zero at the POS, the KDS will automatically void its associated 'add-on' items)
Ticket updated (Ticket Information updated) at POS
Item updated at POS
Item voided at POS
Item modifier updated at POS
Item menu updated at POS
Item course updated at POS
Item voided at POS
Ticket voided at POS
Ticket marked as finished at KDS
Rush item at POS
Item processing status updated at KDS
Addon item processing status updated at KDS
Item processing status updated by course
Pantry message created to item at POS
Pantry message created to the ticket at POS
Ticket merged at POS
Table changed at POS
Update course at POS
Update menu at POS
Setup:
On the top right corner of tickets, there is a hamburger icon button. Clicking it will open the ticket history dialog.
A loading skeleton will be shown when calling the API and waiting for the full response. After that, the ticket history is shown to the user.

requirement.summary: BYOD Module - Add Takeaway Box Setup - API
requirement.description:
Background

New function to add takeaway box to item is needed for OGS, i.e. ordering a relevant item, system auto add a takeaway box to the order.

Setup is needed in POS backend (in BYOD Module or Menu Module) and subsequently sync to OGS through menu sync.

Requirement:

1. Add Setup in POS backend

- New "Takeaway Box Setting" tab under the BYOD Module

Mock up:

- Steps to Add New

- Select "Outlet"

- Select "Item" [Within selected outlet's API Menu (POS Module-> API Settings-> Outlet Menu Settings)]: this is the takeaway box item

- Listing

- Edit Content button

- Delete button

- Name (item name of the takeaway box)

- Code (item code of the takeaway box)

- Can reference "Mix and Match Rules" page to section by outlet

Mock up:

- Can reference "Menu" page to show items bind to each takeaway box

Mock up:

- Edit the items bind to the takeaway box

- Click "Edit Content"

- Only show items within selected outlet's API Menu (POS Module-> API Settings-> Outlet Menu Settings)

- One food item cannot be mapped to more than one takeaway box

2. New API to sync the takeaway box settings to OGS

requirement.summary: TMS2.0 - Display Existing Booking Time, Cover, Reservation Number in Reservation Alert
requirement.description:
User Story:

As a restaurant operator, I want the reservation reminder popup to show each existing booking's time, cover count and confirmation number for a table so that I can quickly see the table's reservation schedule when creating a second or third booking.

Current Behavior:

When staff try to book a table that already has reservations, the reminder popup only indicates that the table has existing reservations. It does not show the booked time slots, cover counts or confirmation numbers, so staff cannot see the table's reservation schedule and must look elsewhere to avoid double-booking or scheduling conflicts.

Expected Behavior:

The reservation reminder popup shows the existing booking details for the exact table being booked. Each existing reservation is listed with its booking time, cover count and confirmation number. Only upcoming reservations for the current or future service period are shown. Reservations for combined/joined tables are not shown.

Acceptance Criteria:

Display existing booking details in reservation reminder

> - Given the table being booked has one or more upcoming reservations for the current or future service period

> - When staff try to book that table and the reservation reminder popup appears

> - Then the popup lists each existing reservation with its booking time, cover count and confirmation number

> - And all three values are shown together for every listed reservation

> - But if any of the three values is missing or empty for a reservation, the popup still displays the reservation with the available values and does not omit or error on that entry

Multiple existing reservations on the same table

> - Given the table being booked has two or more upcoming reservations

> - When the reservation reminder popup appears

> - Then each reservation is listed separately with its own booking time, cover count and confirmation number

> - And the reservations are ordered by booking time in ascending order

> - But if two reservations share the same booking time, both are still listed and neither is hidden or merged

Only upcoming reservations are shown

> - Given the table being booked has past or completed reservations in addition to upcoming ones

> - When the reservation reminder popup appears

> - Then past and completed reservations are not listed

> - And only upcoming reservations for the current or future service period are listed

> - But if a reservation is in progress or currently seated, it is treated as upcoming and is listed

Only the exact table being booked is shown

> - Given the table being booked is combined or joined with other tables that have their own reservations

> - When the reservation reminder popup appears

> - Then only reservations for the exact table being booked are listed

> - But reservations for combined or joined tables are not listed

No existing reservations on the table

> - Given the table being booked has no upcoming reservations for the current or future service period

> - When staff try to book that table

> - Then no existing booking details are shown in the reservation reminder

> - And the booking flow proceeds without displaying a reservation reminder popup

User Story:

Some restaurants allow multiple bookings (2-3 turns) for the same table. Currently, the popup only tells users the table has existing reservations, without showing the booked times. The request is to add the specific reserved time slots in the reminder prompt, so staff can quickly and clearly view the table's reservation schedule when creating subsequent bookings.

Requirement:

Reservation reminder able to show up the time. (-this table has one reservation at 18:00, or there are two reservations at 18:00 and 20:00), when making the second or third reservation, able to see the reservation time,

Use one outlet, one date, and one meal period. Prepare these tables first:

Select T3. A completed or no-show reservation should not open the dialog and should not appear in it.

Add T1 again and click Yes. Both T1 and T6 should stay locked, and you should be able to save.
Reopen the edit view (to reprocess the step), add empty table T7, then add full table T1, then click "No." Only T1 should unlock. T7 and T6 should remain.

1.2 popup

requirement.summary: [Tech] Production diagnostic logger for TMS Operation
requirement.description:
Implement a production diagnostic logger for TMS Operation, separate from the existing action logger.

Goal

Capture important user behaviour in production (clicks, form submits, navigation, API errors/slow calls, uncaught errors), keep logs locally with retention/size limits, and allow users to manually upload logs for debugging.

Scope

- Diagnostic logger core (queue, IndexedDB store, consent, kill switch, upload)

- Collectors: click, form submit, navigation, API (via late-bound axios hook), error / React boundary

- Preference UI: consent, status, upload, clear, enable/disable

- Privacy: sanitize sensitive keys; no passwords/tokens/bodies by default

Performance hardening

- Stop full-store eviction on every flush; evict on init / 5-min interval / pre-upload / throttled overflow

- Gate API logging: always api.error + slow api.response (>=2s); drop fast successes; ignore /rest_api/tms/logs

- Cheapen sanitize key checks (Set exact match + cached list); cache consent/enabled on logger

Out of scope

- Changing ActionLogger behaviour

- New gzip upload endpoint (reuse existing logs endpoint)

requirement.summary: TMS2.0 - "No Notification Deployment Applies" is obscured.
requirement.description:
Precondition:

Go to TMS> Basic Setup> Notification Deployments

- No notifications deployed

Steps To Reproduce:

- Go to TMS Operation > New Reservation page.

- Select outlet, date, period, then click sms icon.

Except Result:

The prompt appears: "No Notification Deployment Applies".

Actual Result:

The "No Notification Deployment Applies" and "No Message Interface Applies" prompts repeatedly appear, with one of them being obscured.
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-68250] TMS2.0 - "No Notification Deployment Applies" is obscured.
Descriptions:
When no Notification Deployments are configured for the outlet, the message prompt on the booking page is displayed incorrectly
Setup:
Go to TMS > Basic Setup > Notification Deployments: No notifications deployed.
Go to TMS Operation > New Reservation page.
After selecting the outlet, date, and period, hovering the mouse over the SMS or Email icon displays the message "No Notification Deployment Applies".
If no message interface is configured for the outlet, the message "No Message Interface Applies" will be displayed.
If the message interface configured for the outlet has been disabled, the message "No Active Message Interface Applies" will be displayed.
The priority of the message prompts is: No Message Interface Applies > No Active Message Interface Applies > No Notification Deployment Applies.

requirement.summary: Cannot show item reminder page after adding set-menu item
requirement.description:
Prerequisite:

1. Add a new item reminder rule with a set menu item

* Location: POS System > Ordering Setup > Item Reminder Rules

* Setup name: Available Options

> Select a set menu item

Workflow:

1. Open a table

2. Click function "Send Check"/ "Print Check"

3. System displays items reminder page

4. Add a set menu item

5. System displays child item selection page

6. Add child items

7. Click button "OK"

8. System fails to show the items reminder page

Expected:

In step 8, system should show the items reminder page
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [JIRA-68925] Cannot show item reminder page after adding set-menu item (Andy)
Descriptions:
System cannot display Item Reminder page correctly after adding set-menu item. An overlay cover blocks all further operation of the Item Reminder page
Workflow
1. Open a table
2. Click function “Send Check”, “Print Check” or “Print And Paid” (depends on Show Reminder Settings)
3. System prompts item reminder page if any unsatisfied rule exists
4. Click the cart icon of a set-menu item
5. System prompts a child-item selection page
6. Select target child item
7. Click button “OK”
8. System fails to bring the Item Reminder page back to the foreground and an overlay remains on the screen blocking further operations
Expected result:
System shows the Item Reminder page above the cover, allowing user to continue operation
It is fixed in current version
Setup:
Setup Item Remind Rules
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System  Ordering Setup  Item Remind Rules
Click “Add New” to add a new record or edit an existing record
Select
Available in Locations = Target Shop or Outlet
Item / Menu = Item type the rule applies to
Available Options = Target set-menu item
Suggestion = Suggest to Order / Force to Order
Fill in the remaining details
Click “Save” to save the record

requirement.summary: KDS2-DEV-08-6 : KDS Device Authentication
requirement.description:
Goal

Let kitchen staff sign in to a KDS device so it can talk to the server and show tickets. Login is for the device, not a personal user account. Staff only need to enter the passcode. Current scope is web only.

Technical context / current problem

Each KDS station is set up once with Tenant ID, Device UID, and region. After that, day-to-day login should be simple: open the app and enter the passcode.

Before this work, the web client did not have a clear, reliable way to:

- Sign in with a passcode and keep a secure session (browser cookie)

- Stay signed in after a page refresh when the session is still valid

- Sign out when the session expires, access is denied, or device settings change

- Open device/connectivity settings when not signed in

- Finish setup after login (handshake and device sync) before showing tickets

Success criteria

-  User only enters the passcode to log in (Tenant ID, Device UID and region are already configured in settings)

-  Invalid passcode or network errors show a clear message on the login screen

-  After a successful login, the app verifies the device session, finishes initial setup, then opens tickets

-  Session stays valid for 1 day, then the user is logged out

-  Refreshing the browser keeps the user signed in if the session is still valid

-  Session ends automatically when it expires, or when the user logs out

-  Protected screens require login; setup and login pages remain available when logged out

-  Changing Tenant ID, Device UID and region logs the user out and requires login again

-  If the server returns unauthorized, the user is sent back to the login screen

-  If the network is briefly unavailable during refresh check, an existing valid session is kept when possible

-  If post-login setup fails, the user is logged out and can try again

-  Login and related messages are translated

Implementation notes

What the user does

- Configure Tenant ID and Device UID in device settings (admin setup in Infrasys Cloud Admin page).

- On the login screen, enter only the passcode and submit.

- Wait for initial setup to finish, then use the tickets screen.

- Log out from the header when needed, or get returned to login if the session ends (including after 1 day).

- If Tenant ID or Device UID is changed in settings, the device is logged out and must sign in again with the passcode.

How it behaves behind the scenes

- Passcode login uses the regional OAuth service and stores the web session in a secure cookie.

- The session is valid for 1 day; the app logs out around expiry so the user must sign in again.

- The app only keeps simple “signed in / expiry” flags locally — not the passcode.

- Changing Tenant ID or Device UID clears the login session (and related device data as needed).

- Logout revokes the server session when possible and clears local login state.

- After login, the app runs handshake and device sync before tickets; failure rolls back to logged out.
